C08.content_en:
Ways to see Google's search suggestions — and how the main tools compare

When you choose a topic, it helps to know what readers search alongside your keyword. The suggestions that appear when you type into the search box are a good hint. There are several ways to see them.

* You can now enter many items, one per line (each is sent one by one, so you pay per item). The table gets an "Input" column. Where the text below says "one", it describes a single item. See the table at the top for the cost.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.002 each (about 500 per $1)Suggestions as a list. Choose country and language. Returns in a few seconds (1.3 measured for "how to start a blog"). Save as CSV
Type into the Google search boxFreeQuick, but you copy each suggestion by hand
UbersuggestSubscription (the Individual plan is listed at $29/month on the official pricing page; see the site for current plans)From keyword ideas to rank and competitor analysis
AnswerThePublicSee the official siteShows question-style suggestions as a visual
Google Keyword PlannerNeeds a Google Ads account with billing details; see the official site for costKeyword ideas inside Google Ads

Checked in November 2026. Prices and free tiers change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you use them.

Why use this tool

  • Back in a few seconds. Try many words without thinking twice.
  • The suggestions come as a list. No copying — save them as CSV.
  • Pay per use, not per daily quota. No monthly fee, about $0.002 each, and $0 in months you do not use it.
  • Pick country and language. See suggestions for markets beyond your own.
  • Just a keyword, plus country and language. With so few settings, you can try it between brainstorming sessions.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want to expand suggestions in bulk with letter prefixes → a dedicated keyword research tool, such as those in the table above, fits better.
  • You want the search volume of each suggestion → this tool lists suggestions only.
  • A few free lookups a day are enough → the Google search box itself will do.

This tool does one thing: show which suggestions Google's search box offers for a keyword, quickly.

FAQ

How many suggestions appear?

In our test ("how to start a blog") there were 15. The number Google returns varies by keyword. There is no option to choose a count.

How is it different from typing into the Google search box?

You get the suggestion list for one word as a table you can save as CSV, with no copying by hand, and you can pick the country and language. It is the same kind of suggestions, paid per use.

When are the suggestions from?

They are what Google returned at the moment you pressed the button, and they can change with time and place.

Some suggestions look oddly written.

The suggestions are shown exactly as Google returned them. Our sample run for "how to start a blog" included entries such as "how to start a blog post" and "how to start a blog page" that read as off-topic. Treat the order as a rough guide and pick suggestions that make sense for your topic.

How can I use the suggestions when planning an article?

They hint at what readers tend to look up next. For "how to start a blog", for instance, the list shows words such as "for free", "and make money" and "on wordpress". The tool only lists suggestions; it does not judge which are good.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?

C23.content_en:
Ways to check how often a topic is asked of AI — and how the main tools compare

When you choose a topic for a book or article, you want to know whether people also ask AI about it. Enter a keyword and this tool shows its monthly search volume on AI platforms as a table of the last 12 months.

* You can now enter many keywords at once, one per line. The table has a "Keyword" column. Where the text below says "one keyword", it describes entering a single keyword. See the table at the top for the cost.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.01 each (measured $0.0101–0.0102; 0.5 s for the "wireless earbuds" sample)One keyword in; monthly AI search volume for 12 months in a table. Save as CSV
Semrush Prompt ResearchSubscription (part of the Semrush AI Visibility Toolkit; see the official site for prices)Finds what people ask AI. Its volume is described as an estimate at the topic level
Google TrendsFreePopularity over time in Google Search. Not the number of AI questions
Google Keyword PlannerFree (needs a Google Ads account; see the official site for conditions)Monthly search volume in Google Search. Not an AI number

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • Only the AI number. See how much is asked of AI, separate from Google search.
  • A 12-month trend. A hint whether a topic is seasonal or a passing spike.
  • About $0.01, a few seconds at most. About 99 per $1, so you can check many topic ideas. Our U.S. sample for "wireless earbuds" took 0.5 seconds and showed 9,245 for October 2026.
  • Pick country and language. See U.S. numbers, or another country's.
  • Save as CSV.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want the Google search volume → this tool is the AI number. Google Keyword Planner and similar tools fit better.
  • You need exact numbers → the tool shows the API's estimate as returned.
  • You want several keywords at once → one keyword per call.
  • A word nobody asks about shows 12 months of zeros and still costs one call (confirmed in an earlier test, not in the U.S. sample).

This tool does one thing: show a keyword's monthly AI search volume over 12 months.

FAQ

What does "AI search volume" count?

The API's estimate of how often the keyword comes up in conversations with AI. This tool cannot tell how it is calculated.

Why do some keywords show zeros?

A word with no sign of being asked of AI shows zeros. A call is still charged.

What is the month column?

Year and month such as "2026-10". The top row is the latest month.

How is it different from Google search volume?

Google volume counts searches in Google. This counts conversations with AI.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?
